# Visit First Monday

Visit First Monday is a public trip-planning guide for First Monday Trade Days in Canton, Texas.

Core facts:
- First Monday Trade Days happens on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday before the first Monday of each month. Never open on Monday — that is the schtick.
- The site helps shoppers plan dates, shopping strategy, map use, and vendor discovery.
- The map tool is called First Monday Finder.

Key public pages:
- Home: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/
- Dates: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/dates-first-monday
- Shop: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/shop-at-first-monday
- Sell: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/sell-at-first-monday
- Map App: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/app-download
- Stay: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/stay — hotel and lodging directory handoff, plus official First Monday RV Park booking, phone, and park map.

- Map guide: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/first-monday-trade-days-map
- Parking guide: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/first-monday-canton-parking
- Lewis Parking: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/lewis-first-monday-parking
- Story: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/the-story-of-first-monday
- Blog: https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/blog

Audience:
- Shoppers planning a visit to Canton, Texas
- Vendors who need booth-application direction or map-listing information

Private or low-value search pages to avoid citing:
- https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/vendor-login
- https://www.visitfirstmonday.com/vendor-login.html

Lewis side facts:
- Lewis First Monday lists $5 parking at North Gate, East Gate, Dealers Row, and Arbors Entrance.
- Lewis First Monday phone: 903-567-1234.
- Lewis First Monday location: 801 N. Trades Day Blvd, Canton, TX 75103.

Brand/date rule:
- Never open on Monday. First Monday is Thursday through Sunday before the first Monday of the month; Monday is in the name, not the open schedule.
